env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group stage closes a dropped or undelivered value only when the chain
# owns it, natively and in the ejected module: a filter-only stage closes
# no element of its source, a filter between maps closes the owned value
# it drops, and a failed filter predicate closes the value it examined.
# chain_stage_closers.lgo prints one ok line per form.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_closers.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_closers.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_closers.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_closers.out
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageclosers

go 1.27
